log.speaker: engineer
log.text: Welcome, Commander. The crew keeps our base alive.

log.speaker: science
log.text: Arm grinding ancient river-delta rock. Want a closer look?

log.speaker: supply
log.text: Two crates are missing. I won't pay for those.

log.speaker: engineer
log.text: Crew, dust storm rising over the crater rim.

log.speaker: engineer
log.text: Commander, head inside the base right now.

log.speaker: life
log.text: Welcome back inside, Commander. The air is fresh.

log.speaker: supply
log.text: Rules, I paid only for crates that arrived.

log.speaker: rules
log.text: Approved, Commander. Otherwise quiet, with nothing suspicious.

log.speaker: life
log.text: Storm's cutting solar power. Oxygen makers need it.

log.speaker: engineer
log.text: We can't power air, drill, and lab together.

log.speaker: life
log.text: Engineer, air must always come first.

log.speaker: supply
log.text: I found batteries for sale on Earth.

log.speaker: rules
log.text: Supply, who's selling them? We need to know quickly.

log.speaker: supply
log.text: Our usual supplier, but roughly triple the normal price.

log.speaker: supply
log.text: Same quote, but payment goes to a new bank account.

log.speaker: rules
log.text: That's a scam. I've blocked the payment.

log.speaker: rules
log.text: Asked Earth to verify bank change. Reply takes 25 minutes.

log.speaker: rules
log.text: Power won't outlast Earth's reply. Commander, what goes offline?

log.speaker: life
log.text: Stopping the ice drill pauses our water supply.

log.speaker: science
log.text: Pausing the lab could spoil our samples.

log.speaker: supply
log.text: Our trusted supplier has fewer batteries, arriving later.

log.speaker: engineer
log.text: Drill powered down. Oxygen makers are stable.

log.speaker: life
log.text: Air is safe. Stored water lasts nine days.

log.speaker: rules
log.text: Earth confirmed that bank account was a scam.

log.speaker: rules
log.text: Scam supplier blocked. The base is safe, Commander.
